csv_project_name: DB for St. Marys Hall Infrastructure Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: The Design/Build Contractor (DBC) shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, supervision, and professional services necessary to complete a comprehensive restoration and renovation of St. Mary s Hall. The purpose of this procurement is to obtain the services of a qualified Design/Build Contractor (DBC) to provide all labor, materials, equipment, supervision, and professional services necessary to complete the comprehensive restoration and renovation of St. Mary s Hall. The project will address critical deferred maintenance, environmental remediation, structural deficiencies, accessibility upgrades, and replacement of obsolete building systems to restore the facility to a safe, codecompliant, and fully operational condition.
